Our Story

The Sound
of East Africa

SMARTBOY MANAGEMENT was founded with a singular mission: to give East African talent the world-class infrastructure it deserves. From the streets of Nairobi to global stages, we close the gap between raw talent and lasting impact.

We are more than a label. We are strategists, storytellers, and advocates — building careers with intention and protecting the art that defines our culture.

With a roster spanning Afro-fusion, drill, trap, and R&B, our sound is as diverse as the continent we represent.

Leadership

The Visionary

PO
Peter Ombati
Founder & CEO
"Music is the language of a generation. Our job is to make sure the world hears it."

Peter Ombati is the founder and chief executive of SMARTBOY MANAGEMENT, one of East Africa's most forward-thinking music and talent companies. With a deep passion for African music and an eye for raw, undiscovered talent, Peter built Smartboy from the ground up — driven by the belief that Kenyan artists deserve world-class management.

Under his leadership, Smartboy has signed and elevated artists across multiple genres, secured brand partnerships, and expanded the label's footprint across East Africa and beyond. Peter's vision is simple: build legacies, not just careers.

What We Do

Full
Spectrum
Support

From signing to stardom, we provide everything an artist needs to build a sustainable, powerful career in the music industry.

Recording & Production
Studio access, producer matchmaking, and full post-production for chart-ready releases.
Talent Management
Day-to-day career strategy, brand identity, and personal development for every artist.
Digital Distribution
Global distribution across Spotify, Apple Music, Audiomack, Boomplay and beyond.
PR & Media
Press, interviews, playlisting, and editorial placements across East Africa and diaspora media.
Brand Partnerships
Connecting our artists with brands that align with their identity and audience.
Touring & Events
Booking, logistics, and performance strategy for live shows and festival appearances.
